clause: Effect masking, selection-scoping + color-managed / bit-depth evaluation [STU-FX-004,STU-FX-006a,STU-FX-010,STU-FX-012a]

scope.summary: Give each StudioLiveFilter entry its own optional StudioMask (raster mask / vector clip / gradient mask), applied only where opaque with the mask's feather; selection-scoping so a live StudioSelectionSet is captured as the entry's effect-region mask (one deduped rule, no separate filter-selection vs filter-layer mode). Enforce typed unit-bearing parameters (radii/offsets in document px, angles in degrees, color params carry explicit StudioColorProfile); evaluate in the layer's declared working space at 8/16/32-bit; descriptor declares supported depths rather than silently degrading.
acceptance_criteria: per-entry StudioMask + selection-scope capture; typed unit-bearing params; 8/16/32-bit color-managed eval; declared supported depths
expected_tests: test: per-entry mask limits effect to opaque region with feather
test: live selection captured as re-editable effect-region mask
test: mixed-unit/implicit-device-color params rejected; 16/32-bit + working-space eval correct

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Effects unmaskable / device-color-unsafe; wrong output outside 8-bit.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
